sentences: A free binary decision diagram evaluates a Boolean function by following variable tests, with no variable tested twice along a root-to-leaf path.
Different paths may inspect variables in different orders.
The saved question asks whether equivalence of two such diagrams can be decided in polynomial time in their representation sizes.
Comparing their graph shapes is insufficient because structurally different diagrams can still agree on every assignment.

An efficient exact test would support reliable manipulation of flexible decision representations, and the 2002 table entry remains a dated question rather than evidence of a newly checked complexity classification.
